summary: A Yes vote revises the City of Costa Mesa's business license tax structure and rates.

tax.text: A Yes vote would increase business license payments for larger businesses and generate approximately $4.6 million annually for general City services.
tax.quote: Supports locally controlled City services: Measure C is estimated to generate approximately $4.6 million annually for general City services

tax.text: A No vote would leave the current business license system in place and would not generate the measure's estimated additional revenue for City services.
